title:
Commission earner?
*The bank counts 70%*

lines.say: You earn 10,000 dollars a month, all commission. The bank counts only 7,000.
Banks must cut variable income by at least 30%, using your last 12 months.
Your debt limit is 55% of what they count: 3,850 dollars a month, not 5,500.
Tested at 4% over 30 years, that's a loan of about 806,000.
On a fixed 10,000 salary, it's about 1.15 million.
So plan your budget on what the bank sees, not what you earn.
